ctx.x: minutes and say, "Can you play with this for ninety minutes?" "Yeah, how about just bass and percussion for ninety minutes?" We can do this, and trust my sense of musical maturity and skill, I could do that. Those projects interest me. But you need new guys, need new filmmakers to do that, guys who are twenty five just come out of college who are not stuck into the Henry Mancini scores, which are great. At the time you had a cast of thousands on the screen and a cast of five hundred in the orchestra. Well that's…
You actually won a Grammy for a composition …
Yeah, me and Billy and Herbie for Call Sheet Blues for the 'Round Midnight picture. Nice melody, too, by the way. Yeah.
